meta.title: Ask your company anything: voice-over for both cuts, English and French
meta.voices: Chosen in one place, pipeline/voice/voices.json (en.voice, fr.voice). No line carries a voice name or an SSML voice tag, so swapping the temporary French voice for a West or Central African one is one setting.
meta.rule: The voice never covers a typing window. Every line starts at its start time in both languages and ends by end_by.

fields.start: seconds on the edit timeline where the line begins, the same in English and French
fields.end_by: the latest the line may end: the next typing window, the next line, or the end of the shot
fields.text: the line as a reader sees it in the scripts and subtitles (₦38.2m in English; French typography in French)
fields.spoken: what the voice reads: amounts, times and acronyms written out; [pause Nms] markers become silences when the lines are voiced (pipeline/voice/)
fields.words: spoken words, split on spaces and hyphens; a spelled acronym (C.O.O., CFA, J.B.S.) counts one word per two letters
fields.est_s: words ÷ rate × 60, plus the pauses, in seconds

meta.typing_windows_note: Typing at 12 characters a second; windows from storyboard.md.

typing.question: Who is late at Apapa today, and what’s waiting on me?

en.text: 07:45. Before the COO asks anything, Ndali Group reports: yesterday’s sales, cash in naira and CFA francs, 5 stock-outs, and who is in.

fr.spoken: Sept heures quarante-cinq. [pause 300ms] Avant toute question, Ndali Group rend compte : [pause 200ms] les ventes de la veille, la trésorerie en nairas et en francs CFA, cinq ruptures de stock, et l’effectif présent.

en.spoken: Three approvals are waiting: a leave request, an expense claim and a purchase order.
